engineApi.name: panel
engineApi.description: {open, tab:'now'|'10day', fcLoc:{lat,lng}|null, fc10Loaded} â€” replaces DOM .active/.hidden toggles split across app.js:413-418 and weather.js:203-217

engineApi.name: now
engineApi.description: {status:'idle'|'loading'|'ready'|'offline-empty'|'error', locLabel, vm:{cards[],rows[]}, staleLabel, fromCache}

engineApi.name: fc10
engineApi.description: {status, locLabel, forArea, days:[{key,wd,md2,dayOut,longRange,emo,desc,hi,lo,windMax,gust,wdir,windColor,waveFt,wavePer,waveDir,swellFt,swellPer,pop,rainSum,sst,uv,sunrise,sunset,strip[]}], staleLabel, fromCache}

engineApi.name: openWeatherPanel
engineApi.description: Replaces loadWeatherPanel: resets to the Now tab, clears fcLoc and fc10Loaded, runs loadNow24. Must go through the shared panel-open path (clamp height and sync tabs).

engineApi.name: setWeatherTab
engineApi.description: Switch tabs. Choosing 10day when !fc10Loaded sets the latch and loads 10-day (the latch resets on failure).

engineApi.name: showAreaForecast
engineApi.description: (ll) Close other panels, open weather on 10-Day for ll (fcLoc), also load Now (GPS or centre). Overwrites the fishapp.fc10 cache.

engineApi.name: loadNow24
engineApi.description: Cache-first, deduped Now load (also the Retry action). Location is GPS.lastLatLng or map centre.

engineApi.name: loadForecast10
engineApi.description: (override?) Cache-first, deduped 10-day load (also the Retry action). Location is override || fcLoc || GPS || centre.

engineApi.name: tickAutoRefresh
engineApi.description: Every 10 min: if visible, online and the panel is open, run loadNow24, plus loadForecast10 when fc10Loaded.

engineApi.name: getCachedNow / getCachedFc10
engineApi.description: Raw localStorage payloads fishapp.lastwx and fishapp.fc10 (shape unchanged) for assistant.js and bite.js.

engineApi.name: compass, dirArrow, windColor, wxNum, MS_TO_FT, wmoIcon, wxAgeLabel
engineApi.description: Pure formatters exported for bite, catch, goto, assistant and inspect.

engineApi.name: wind
engineApi.description: {on, playing, hourOffset, timeLabel, framesLoaded}

engineApi.name: windLoopToggle
engineApi.description: Play/pause the 24 h loop. Auto-enables the overlay (and persists the pref) if off. Online only.

engineApi.name: windScrub
engineApi.description: (v) Pause and show forecast hour v, building frames on demand.

engineApi.name: setOverlay
engineApi.description: (kind:'wind'|'rain'|'sst'|'fish', on) Enable or disable and persist to fishapp.layers. Also used by the First Mate toggle_layer tool. Rain and SST refuse offline and emit overlay:uncheck.

engineApi.name: rain
engineApi.description: {on, playing, frameCount, idx, timeLabel, isForecastFrame}

engineApi.name: rainTogglePlay / rainScrub
engineApi.description: Play/pause (needs â‰¥ 2 frames and online) and jump to a frame (pauses).

engineApi.name: sst
engineApi.description: {on, playing, loadingLoop, palette, rangeC, rangeF, dateLabel}

engineApi.name: sstTogglePlay / sstSetPalette
engineApi.description: Preload and play the 5-day loop, or stop. Change palette (persists fishapp.sstpal; rebuilds if on).

engineApi.name: getSstRange
engineApi.description: SST.range [minC,maxC] for the assistant's water-temp answer.

engineApi.name: fish
engineApi.description: {on, count, total} â€” markers stay imperative in Leaflet.

engineApi.name: inspect
engineApi.description: {open, ll, distLine, results:{depth,wind,swell,sst}}, each 'loading'|'offline'|'nodata'|'error'|value

engineApi.name: inspectAt
engineApi.description: (latlng) Map click when nav mode didn't consume it. Normalises lng, bumps reqId, opens the popup, queries the point.

engineApi.name: inspectSaveSpot / inspectNavigate / inspectAreaForecast
engineApi.description: Close the popup, then openSpotModal({lat,lng}) / gotoStart(ll,'Pin lat3, lng3') / showAreaForecast(ll).

engineApi.name: queryPointData
engineApi.description: (ll, results, onUpdate) Shared depth, wind, swell and SST fetcher (reefs.js reuses it).

engineApi.name: toast
engineApi.description: Emitted with the exact strings listed in spec Â§4 (replaces direct toast() calls).

engineApi.name: overlay:uncheck
engineApi.description: Rain or SST refused offline, so untick the toggle (at boot, without persisting).

engineApi.name: weather:fc10-saved
engineApi.description: Optional: lets the bite engine and conditions watch re-evaluate after a new 10-day payload is cached.

weather.js, inspect.js, fish.js and rain.js define global state objects (WX, Inspect, Fish, Rain) and constants only; no DOM, map or network access at load
wxInit(map) (app.js:232) adds the map 'moveend zoomend' listener; fishInit(map) (app.js:242) adds the map 'moveend' listener
sstEnable binds the map 'moveend' lazily, once, on the first online enable, and never unbinds it (sst.js:49-58)
app.js:497 setInterval 10 min drives loadNow24 and loadForecast10 while the weather panel is open
